title: Watch a Broadway musical

location.label: Broadway Theatre District, New York City

description: Find a musical whose story catches your interest, then make an evening of it in New York’s Theatre District. The lights dim, the orchestra begins, and songs carry the characters’ feelings farther than conversation could. Broadway offers everything from intimate new stories to large ensemble productions; browsing the current lineup is part of the pleasure, and no single show has to define the experience.
teaser: Choose a show and let live music carry you into its world.
goodToKnow: Check the current Broadway lineup, performance schedule, running time, and official ticket options before choosing a show.
whyItMightDelightYou: The thrill is shared: performers, musicians, and an entire audience discover the same story together in real time.
